title: treeroute v1: engine, rival tools and scripts for five environmental forecasting problems
description: Code and key text records for the paper "Ridge weighting of other regions' regression trees, anchored to the seasonal normal: a temporal hold-out test on five environmental forecasting problems". The method's engine is treeroute v1, reference version 930d961c. The repository holds the engine, every earlier code version that the paper names, the rival code, the coral table builders, the rebuild and environment files, the analysis and figure scripts and the key text records; README.md describes each folder. The run records and the row-level predictions are in the linked data record "treeroute v1: run records and row-level predictions for five environmental forecasting problems".
